titulo: Skipping the Gym? Like a Peasant. (Funny Gym Motivation)
descripcion:
Skipping the gym again? That's peasant behavior. Cella is sunk into the couch, hears "like a peasant," and takes it personally: up, gym bag, out the door. One squat later she's back on the floor. Then she gets up and goes again.

How do you go to the gym when you don't feel like it? Most people who keep going say the same thing: don't wait to feel motivated. Pack the bag, get out the door, and promise yourself just one exercise. One squat still counts as showing up.

A short cartoon about gym motivation for lazy days.

comentario_fijado: What's your go-to excuse for skipping the gym? Wrong answers only.
alt: A 19-second vertical cartoon about skipping the gym. Cella, a small dark doorway-shaped figure with white eyes and a flat red crown, is sunk into a purple sofa. Voice, no on-screen text: a dry voice says she could skip the gym, like a peasant. Offended, she gets up and leaves with her gym bag, comes back flattened after one squat, then reinflates and stands at the open door with the bag, ready to go again.
